change_summary: Run NFL ledger standard-library regressions on the exact PR head and add a separate, synthetic, cross-PR end-to-end acceptance job pinning runner commit 12c667a20cd452a5732a3fec9d429caf5b4280da. Test frozen board/source hashes, output and settlement row/quote IDs, selection tri-state, and zero approved units. No model/pricing or betting release changes.

The cross-PR acceptance test mocks upstream v5.run predictions while executing the actual runner guards, card selection, CSV export, freeze, settlement and scorecard. It cannot validate v5 simulations or model accuracy.
Runner SHA 12c667a20cd452a5732a3fec9d429caf5b4280da is pinned independently of the ledger HEAD. A newer runner commit requires a new integration pin and fresh CI evidence.
Private real CIN@WAS 117-row/source receipt validation is outside these synthetic CI checks; synthetic settlements must never count as real wagering results.
